Kumthalakadi Video Song from Mannan Tamil movie featuring Rajinikanth and Vijayashanti. Mannam Tamil movie also stars Khushboo, Visu, Goundamani, Manorama and Pandari Bai among others. Music by Ilayaraja,directed by P Vasu and produced by Prabhu.
Song : Kumthalakadi
Singer : SPB
Music : Ilayaraja
Lyrics : Vaali
